args.body: If supplier selection is still open, read the Police Scotland award extraction and verify which supplier holds the migration obligation by matching the contract awardID to the original award and its lot. If supplier selection or retrieval is already underway, reuse it. Apply the remaining two-page allowance to the selected supplier's own current invitation and response instructions. If they establish a paid fit, tie a small fictional migration acceptance check to the exact requirement, execute passing and failing controls, and preserve the observed output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise record the precise gap and what new evidence would reopen the test. Read the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.
